'''Shannon Baksa''' (later '''Shannon Lynn McRandle''', née Jones) is the model Decipher cast as Mara Jade. She was a special guest at [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 2000]]. Her likeness is on [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] from [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]] and on the Light Side [[Mara Jade]] from Virtual Set 17. She is the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000), the first official flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade.<ref name="databank">[https://web.archive.org/web/20110807051128/http://starwars.com/databank/character/marajadeskywalker/index.html Mara Jade Skywalker], Star Wars Databank (Wayback 7 August 2011)</ref><ref name="tfn">[http://www.theforce.net/videogames/story/Shannon_Baksa_is_Mara_Jade_78191.asp Shannon Baksa is Mara Jade], TheForce.net (12 November 1999)</ref><ref name="pc-x">[https://x.com/swccg/status/1828839249443262568 @swccg], 28 August 2024</ref><ref name="wook-47">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_47 Star Wars Insider 47], Wookieepedia. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170620212824/http://starwars.wikia.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Insider_47 Wayback, 20 June 2017].</ref>

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Shannon Baksa signing.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Baksa signing at DecipherCon 2000, 6 October 2000]]

Decipher's DecipherCon '99 guest bio called her Star Wars' "Mara Jade": a professional model and make-up artist, cast by Decipher, who would sign photographs at the convention.<ref name="bio">[https://web.archive.org/web/20000304010455/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/specialguests/shannonbio.html Shannon Baksa — Star Wars' "Mara Jade"], Decipher (Wayback 4 March 2000)</ref>

== Convention guest ==

At DecipherCon '99 (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach) she signed Friday 1–3pm and Saturday/Sunday 12–2pm. Francis K. Lalumiere wrote that she appeared as Mara Jade in full costume.<ref name="sat">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001120012500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/lalumiere/saturday.html Lalumiere Saturday], DecipherCon '99 (Wayback)</ref>

At DecipherCon 2000 (5–8 October 2000, Kissimmee) she returned with [[Michonne Bourriague]]. Surviving official photographs show her signing table (6 October) and a magazine feature "Who is Mara Jade?" (8 October).

[[File:DecipherCon 2000 Who is Mara Jade.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Baksa as Mara Jade in the green costume at DecipherCon 2000, 8 October 2000. Official gallery caption: magazine feature "Who is Mara Jade?"]]

== Star Wars Insider 47 ==

[[File:Star Wars Insider 47 Mara Jade cover.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Shannon McRandle as Mara Jade on the cover of ''Star Wars Insider'' 47 (January 2000).<ref name="wook-47" />]]
[[File:Mara Jade Flesh and Blood.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Shannon McRandle as Mara Jade, from Scott Chernoff's article "Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood" in ''Star Wars Insider'' 47.<ref name="wook-fab">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mara_Jade:_Flesh_and_Blood#cite_note-Insider_47-1 Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood], Wookieepedia (cite Insider 47). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250418063630/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Mara_Jade:_Flesh_and_Blood Wayback, 18 April 2025].</ref>]]

''Star Wars Insider'' 47 is the forty-seventh issue of the official Lucasfilm fan magazine. It was published in January 2000 (StarWars.com dated the street date 3 January 2000). Editor Jon Bradley Snyder. Publisher The Fan Club, Inc. / Fantastic Media. 82 pages. ISSN 1041-5122. The issue featured the first flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade, as portrayed by Shannon McRandle for Decipher's ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game.<ref name="wook-47" /><ref name="sw-streets">[https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news20000103.html New Star Wars Insider #47 Hits the Streets], StarWars.com (3 January 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20051205134152/https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news20000103.html Wayback, 5 December 2005].</ref>

On 27 October 1999 StarWars.com previewed the upcoming cover as the first official flesh-and-blood image of Mara Jade. Mara would appear on her own Decipher CCG card, but ''Insider'' would print those images first, with an interview about her rise to popularity by creator Timothy Zahn. The issue was scheduled for late December.<ref name="sw-preview">[https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news19991027c/index.html Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood], StarWars.com (27 October 1999). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110703035710/https://www.starwars.com/community/fanclub/mag/news19991027c/index.html Wayback, 3 July 2011].</ref>

The 3 January 2000 street notice: Chewbacca and Mara Jade (the new Mrs. Luke Skywalker) share the spotlight, and Mara "graces the cover of Insider #47." The cover story has exclusive interviews with Zahn and "the woman tapped to become the first 'flesh and blood' version of Mara, Shannon Baksa."<ref name="sw-streets" />

The feature '''Mara Jade: Flesh and Blood''' (Scott Chernoff, pages 52–57) is the magazine's Mara shoot story. Wookieepedia's issue contents quote the published blurb:<ref name="wook-47" /><ref name="wook-fab" />

:Finally, an all-out look at the most popular character in the ''Star Wars'' Expanded Universe! Scott Chernoff goes behind the scenes at the photo shoot for Mara Jade's new Decipher card—the first "life-action" rendering of the new Mrs. Skywalker—and talks to character creator Timothy Zahn about the evolution and future of the former Emperor's Hand. It's a Mara Jade blow-out!

The article covers Mara's first portrayal by a real human being, on [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] from [[Enhanced Jabba's Palace]]. On the card Mara was portrayed by Shannon McRandle (as Shannon Baksa). McRandle is interviewed; she talks about her excitement at being chosen and the steps she took to prepare.<ref name="wook-fab" />

== Likeness on SWCCG cards ==

The Star Wars Databank: "Decipher Inc. hired model Shannon Baksa to pose as Mara for a number of card images. Many subsequent products have since borne Baksa's likeness to represent Mara." The first cited product is the live-action photo for Enhanced Jabba's Palace.<ref name="databank" />

[[File:EJP-D-marajadetheemperorshand.gif|thumb|left|200px|[[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]], Enhanced Jabba's Palace]]
[[File:V17-L-marajade.gif|thumb|right|200px|[[Mara Jade]], Virtual Set 17]]

* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] — Enhanced Jabba's Palace premium (die-cut pack with [[Bossk With Mortar Gun]] and [[You Can Either Profit By This...]])
* The same title as a Reflections II foil
* Oversized Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand convention promo (spend $20 at the Decipher store)
* Oversized group promo: Mara Jade, Corran Horn & Talon Karrde (same store promo)
* [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] — Virtual Set 26 reprint of the same photograph
* Virtual Block 4 [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber (Dark)|Mara Jade With Lightsaber]] overlay uses the same Enhanced Jabba's Palace photograph
* Light Side [[Mara Jade]] (Virtual Set 17) — Players Committee: "Mrs. McRandle image also appears on the LS Card Mara Jade from V-Set 17."<ref name="pc-x" />

Art director Dan Burns ran a local-model search; she later appeared as a Decipher convention representative with a lit lightsaber. Decipher also shot her in a green Light Side costume at that session and planned a Light Side Mara Jade card, but never printed it. Extra shots "featured her in a green military jumpsuit. I'm pretty sure the plan for that was to be her Light Side version." Another designer: "The Light Side Mara Jade was unfortunate as the costume was made, Shannon was ready and it was shot. It just never made it onto a card (I don't know why)." The Players Committee later used that work for Virtual Set 17, "a card some might say has been 20 years in the making."<ref name="set17">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/light-side-mara-jade-virtual-set-17-spoiler/ Light Side Mara Jade, Virtual Set 17 spoiler], Players Committee (4 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230303022134/https://www.starwarsccg.org/light-side-mara-jade-virtual-set-17-spoiler/ Wayback, 3 March 2023].</ref>

== Interviews ==

=== NanashiStudios, 10 December 2021 ===

[[File:Shannon McRandle 2021 interview.png|thumb|right|280px|Shannon McRandle, Mara Jade]]

brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted ''Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview'' on 10 December 2021 (7 minutes 54 seconds). She is on camera from about 0:18. The title marks it as a preview.<ref name="mcrandle">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oOX0cT3ukR8 Shannon McRandle (Mara Jade) Preview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (10 December 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-oOX0cT3ukR8 Internet Archive].</ref>

She introduces herself as Shannon McRandle, formerly Shannon Baksa, hired as the living face of Mara Jade for Decipher's ''Star Wars'' game cards. A ''Star Wars Insider'' poll had made Mara the fan-favorite character who had never been on film. The casting call asked for a 5'9–5'10 redhead, dancer-type, strong. The photographer already shooting the project brought her in before the call; Decipher then cancelled the open casting.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She describes herself as an old-school board-game player. Her first meeting was at Decipher, then a comic shop to research Mara. Decipher had mock-ups of comic covers and artist ideas; Mara had never had one look. She read the first two Zahn novels before the second interview. For the shoot she lightened her hair orangey-red and wore green contacts.<ref name="mcrandle" />

She calls Mara the first female character who was almost the opposite of Leia: a bad guy you fall in love with. On the work itself: "if it had just been that one day that one card and a couple of DecipherCons I would have been ecstatic." Being Mara introduced her to the wider ''Star Wars'' world; she dates that span as 20 of her 50 years. She says she would not call herself iconic: "Mara Jade is iconic and to have been able to stand in her boots for a moment."<ref name="mcrandle" />
